mountains-peak.assessment: PASS all eight. All are transparent 96x96 with binary alpha, one connected silhouette, symmetric horizontal bounds around x=47.5, and feet on row 93. Widths are 82,80,76 / 60,52,52 / 40,36px; big heights are 74,66,67px. Native single-pixel contour and strata detail is present; no doubled-pixel upscale pattern was observed. The silhouettes include unequal double summits, a central triple crag, a broad ridge shoulder, a plateau, a sharp spike and two different knolls. Cool grey lit left faces contrast against dark right faces and the brown base. Dark outlines read cleanly on both light and dark mattes. Texture follows the rock planes; no rejectable blur, antialiasing, detached pixels, pale halo, muddy silhouette, near-duplicate or palette clash with approved art was found. Both randomized A2 lattices and the ragged edge were examined at exact 1x/4x; individual sprites were examined at 1x/4x/8x. The overlapping crowd has a jagged varied skyline and recognisable rock masses rather than identical cones or an egg-crate pattern. Restrained olive grass at the feet anchors each summer sprite and agrees with the approved vegetation. The strong pale rock bands remain rock strata rather than unintended white fringe.

approved-base-context.assessment: The two bases are explicitly approved and stay under Part A2. They are context, not additional A2 pass/fail entries. Rebuilt and visually inspected both 3x3 repeats at 1x and 4x. Both are opaque 288x288. Summer has rock, scree, small boulders and sparse tufts; winter has directional snow texture with exposed rock. Individual boulder clusters recur in the deliberately repeated 3x3 diagnostic, but no straight join or cell-boundary grid is introduced by the peak sprites. Peak overlap breaks up the exposed-ground recurrence in the actual range composites. No base changes are requested.

review-scope.assessment: Only BRIEF-5 Part A2 receives verdicts: mountains-peak-0..7 and mountains@winter-peak-0..7, without .png. critic-r5A2-0.json does not exist. The named old summer/winter mountain references were compared for the egg-crate failure; the named current-fantasy-treeline_forest reference was also planted as a forest and inspected at 1x/4x to check the standing-sprite overlap model. Approved markers, round-2 city/industry/slums/suburb/farmland cells, paddies, grass/plains bases and details supplied pixel density, outline, lighting and palette context. No Part B/C/D files are judged: crater scale, classical ruins, cyberpunk grids, autumn hues and crown variety belong to those parts.
